items.response: Using standard conversions, rounded: flour 1 1/2 cups is about 190 g, sugar 1 cup is about 200 g, butter 1/2 cup is 113 g, plain yogurt 1/2 cup is about 120 g, lemon juice 2 tbsp is about 30 g, and baking powder 1 tsp is about 4 g. Flour is the one that varies most by how it's scooped, so 190 g is based on about 125 g per cup. Action: save this gram version of the lemon loaf to your notes so you have it next time.

Action: pull the current requirements and fee from the official passport site and look up the earliest appointment options near you, then send both to you.
